name: Seek ~Chikashitsu no Mesu Dorei-tachi~
source:
While attending the funeral of a father his hasn't seen in 10 years, our guy found out about his father's job of SM painter, but actually a SM trainer and Will of one billion yen, now half to his assistant and half to an orphanage. If he can become a SM trainer in one month, assistant will be judge, then he can get the whole one billion yen. Well, how well he can train three girls will have different outcomes.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主人公参加阔别10年的父亲的葬礼，这才得知父亲表面上是一名SM画家，真实职业却是SM调教师。父亲还留下10亿日元遗产，其中一半归助手，另一半捐给孤儿院。如果主人公能在1个月内成为合格的SM调教师，并通过助手的评判，就能独得全部10亿日元。至于他能把3名女孩调教到什么程度，将导向不同结局。

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
